is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.l. (page 5, 2.4.3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions that a subset of Anopheles gambiae mosquitoes were assessed for the presence of the kdr mutation (page 5, 2.4.3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: While the paper mentions that a subset of Anopheles gambiae were assessed for kdr, it does not report the actual genotype counts or frequencies in the text, tables, or figures.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in the Kisantu Health Zone, Democratic Republic of the Congo (page 3, 2.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a quasi-experimental field study.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in the Kisantu Health Zone, Kongo-Central province (page 3, 2.1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from January to December 2018 (page 1, Abstract).

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a new field study conducted in 2018.

supplement.evidence: The paper mentions that kdr mutation assessment was performed, but no data is provided in the main text or the provided supplementary file (which only contains abdominal stage distribution).

assessment.summary: A quasi-experimental study in Kisantu Health Zone, DRC, comparing PBO-treated LLINs and standard pyrethroid-only LLINs. While the study mentions kdr mutation testing for Anopheles gambiae, no genotype data is reported.
exclusion_reasons: reports_extractable_genotype_data: The paper mentions that a subset of Anopheles gambiae were assessed for the kdr mutation, but it does not provide the resulting genotype counts or frequencies.
